units.source_text: 次年春，二月二十过后，皇上于南殿举行樱花宴会。

en.t: The following spring, after the twentieth day of the second month had passed, the Emperor held a cherry blossom banquet in the Southern Hall.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后及朱雀院皇太子的御座，设在皇上玉座的两旁，皇后及皇太子皆赴席。

en.t: The seats for Empress Fujitsubo and Crown Prince Suzaku-in were placed on either side of the Emperor's throne, and both the Empress and the Crown Prince attended the banquet.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御为了藤壶皇后占据上风，心中每感不快，常常避免同席。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort was often displeased that Empress Fujitsubo held the higher position, and she usually avoided sitting at the same gathering.

units.source_text: 但此次观赏美景，未便一人向隅，只得也来赴席。

en.t: But since this occasion was for enjoying the beautiful scenery, it would not do for her alone to stay away in gloom, so she had no choice but to attend as well.
